title.alt: Smash title screen showing a mode-selection box over a blue sky, with P1 VS P2 selected.
title.title: Choose the match.
title.caption: The title screen begins at the mode list.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: W / S picks a mode.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: Enter or J opens fighter select.

lobby.alt: Fighter lobby showing Mario, Simon, Tommy, and Rizer in a two-by-two selection grid, with Simon selected in green.
lobby.title: Pick a fighter.
lobby.caption: The lobby holds all four fighters in one connected grid.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: The red frame is P1. A / D chooses a fighter.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: The green frame belongs to P2.

annotations.label: C
annotations.note: Enter or J starts the fight.

battle.alt: Opening battle screen with Mario on the left, Simon on the right, both at zero percent, and a single brick platform between them.
battle.title: The round opens clean.
battle.caption: Mario and Simon begin apart on one long platform.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Damage is not health: a bigger % means a bigger shove.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: P1 starts on the left.

annotations.label: C
annotations.note: Catch the top to land. Jump through it from below.

jump.alt: Mario rises over the left side of the platform while Simon stays grounded.
jump.title: Take to the air.
jump.caption: Mario is above the platform while Simon remains grounded.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Up jumps. Release Up, then press it again for the second jump.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: Land on top to reset both jumps.

jab.alt: Mario extends his kick on the left. Simon stands beyond its reach, at zero damage.
jab.title: This jab misses.
jab.caption: The extended kick stops short; neither counter changes.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Too far! The kick misses.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: Simon is still at 0% — no hit spark.

special.alt: Mario on the left with a small fireball between him and Simon on the right; both damage counters remain at zero percent.
special.title: A fireball crosses the gap.
special.caption: Mario’s projectile is visible between the two fighters.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: K launches a fireball.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: Follow the shot. Use J when you get close.

jump-press.alt: Mario leaves the ground after the first Up press. Simon remains on the platform.
jump-press.title: Press W
jump-press.caption: The first press lifts Mario off the platform.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Tap W to leave the ground.

jump-release.alt: Mario falls after the first jump with Up released.
jump-release.title: Let go!
jump-release.caption: Up stays released as the first jump ends.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Let go of W. You still have a jump.

jump-again.alt: A fresh Up press sends Mario upward again before he lands.
jump-again.title: Press W again
jump-again.caption: The second fresh press reverses the fall.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Tap W again. Back up you go.

hit.alt: Mario’s kick connects with Simon. A spark appears at contact, Simon rises in a hurt pose, and his damage reads 6%.
hit.title: That one lands.
hit.caption: Close the gap: the same jab now hits.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: J connects. Look for the spark.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: Simon goes from 0% to 6%.

annotations.label: C
annotations.note: The hit lifts Simon into his hurt pose.

simon-special.alt: Simon stands on the left while his thrown axe rises above the platform.
simon-special.title: Throw over their head.
simon-special.caption: Simon’s axe climbs before it falls.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: K throws the axe up and forward.

tommy-special.alt: Tommy holds a high extended kick on the left. Simon stands on the right.
tommy-special.title: Put a foot through the gap.
tommy-special.caption: Tommy’s special is a kick.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: Press K for the longer kick. Keep steering.

rizer-special.alt: Rizer curls in the air with a small bullet to his right. Simon remains grounded.
rizer-special.title: Shoot on the way through.
rizer-special.caption: Rizer fires without leaving his airborne curl.

annotations.label: A
annotations.note: W, then K: the bullet travels straight.

annotations.label: B
annotations.note: He keeps the curl while airborne.
